description.value: An Australian Medicare Card Number is assigned by Services Australia under the Australian Federal Government Medicare program. The medicare identifier system may be used for the 10 digit Medicare card number or the 11 digit number that includes the individual reference number (IRN). Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).

usage.value: Australian Federal Government funded medical insurance patient identification

comment.value: This value is used for Australian FHIR Implementations.
This value is used for the 11 digit Medicare numbers in Australian CDA documents and OID based systems.
This value is used for the 10 digit Medicare numbers in Australian CDA documents and OID based systems.
